headline: @gta6latest: Rockstar is reportedly in talks with Miami-Dade County to temporarily re-theme parts...
body: Rockstar is reportedly in talks with Miami-Dade County to temporarily re-theme parts of Miami as Vice City for GTA 6 marketing. The plan would include Vice City-style signage and branding at Miami Airport, Downtown Miami and other major locations, turning real-life Miami into a live promotional backdrop ahead of the game’s launch. If it happens, it would easily be one of the biggest video game marketing campaigns Rockstar has ever done.
caption:
Rockstar is reportedly in talks with Miami-Dade County to temporarily re-theme parts of Miami as Vice City for GTA 6 marketing. The plan would include Vice City-style signage and branding at Miami Airport, Downtown Miami and other major locations, turning real-life Miami into a live promotional backdrop ahead of the game’s launch. If it happens, it would easily be one of the biggest video game marketing campaigns Rockstar has ever done.
